reviews.text: Thanks for the 5 stars, Irene!
Thanks, Marko!

Very professional vet! I’ve used 4 different clinics in NL, and this is theeeee best and most professional one! All the vets have huge love and patience on cats, not just doing their daily job. Also price is very reasonable and transparent considering the good service.
Busy veterinary clinic in Oud-Zuid. Everyone was very sweet and caring towards little Leo, who was getting a health check after a long flight.
Highly recommended. 😻 …
Clearly another veterinarian who wants to make money.
super friendly staff, gave us amazing recommendations for our cats and even gave them free toys bc they "behaved so good". made us (and our cats) feel incredibly happy and welcome

Our vet in Haarlem recommended us Dierenkliniek Vondelpark when we moved to Amsterdam. My two cats and I feel very very well taken care of by the Team. Everyone is super loving and extremely friendly. We are more than happy with Doctor Mariana Gomes and her helping hands 🤍!! We can have open and honest conversations, and no questions remain unanswered. Both my blind cat and my other quite shy one both don’t seem stressed during our visits, also thanks to their special cat area ❣️all in all, you’re doing an amazing job and we’re happy to to be able to count on you. Thanks!🙏
Thanks Nick!
Thank you :)!

Super help, day and night! You can always turn to them if there is a problem. Even when you are feeling unwell yourself, they think along with you and offer help wherever possible. An incredibly dedicated and helpful team!

It has been very difficult for me to write this review. Even now, it is still incredibly painful to accept that my beloved Businka is no longer with me.

I would like to express my deepest gratitude to Dr. Nirita Brand. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your kindness, compassion, and professionalism. You were so gentle and respectful throughout the entire process. You gave me all the time I needed to say goodbye to my precious girl, never rushed me, and supported me through every step of the hardest decision I have ever had to make. I will always be grateful for your empathy and care. You are not only an outstanding veterinarian but also a truly wonderful person.

I would also like to thank the entire team at the clinic. Every member of the staff treated us with kindness, care, patience, and compassion. Your support during the most difficult moment of my life meant more than I can express.

Thank you all for your warm hearts, your dedication, and for treating both your patients and their families with such humanity. I will never forget your kindness.
Thanks for the nice review, Tim!

I’m very happy with this clinic. Every time one of my cats has been unwell, they’ve been incredibly helpful.

The first time I went, I called because I couldn’t get an appointment anywhere else and my cat wasn’t able to urinate, so I was extremely worried. They managed to fit us in, examined him, and took care of him. He was given antibiotics and, although he had a relapse later on, they redid his treatment, changed his diet, and he’s been doing perfectly ever since.

All of the vets and nurses are very gentle with cats and handle them with great care, which I really appreciate. They take everything you tell them seriously and investigate thoroughly, even when the problem doesn’t initially seem severe. They also answer my questions about following up on WhatsApp or when I call them and I appreciate it.

I’ll definitely keep bringing my little ones to this clinic.

Super friendly and knowledgeable staff who truly take the time to care for your pet and ensure the best possible treatment. I used to visit another clinic in Amsterdam South where appointments felt rushed and you were sent away after just a few minutes due to understaffing and lack of patience. Here, you can genuinely feel the love and care they have for animals.

Top- notch dierenkliniek! I love that it’s easily accessible via tram and that they offer a pet health plan (when combined with pet insurance, it makes vet costs very manageable)! Everyone at the practice is so kind and helpful. I trust them with everything for my dog.
Bad, I'm not going there anymore, they're crazy there.
Great professionals. Always ready to help your pet. Very responsive and very attentive. Thank you very much together with my pet.

They are always helpful, caring, and attentive. My cat gets quite nervous during vet visits, but the team consistently handles him with patience and kindness. They really take the time to make him feel as comfortable as possible and look for solutions that minimize stress and avoid creating any trauma.

I truly appreciate the level of care and thoughtfulness they show every time we visit. Very happy with their service and would definitely recommend them.

I booked my pet’s deworming service through their WhatsApp. The customer service was very attentive and friendly. However, as I am a foreign customer, I had to cancel the appointment due to some objective reasons. Despite that, throughout the booking process, the staff provided me with a lot of help, and I am very grateful!

We’re sorry to see that you had a disappointing experience with us.

Unfortunately, we are unable to identify you in our client records based on the name used for this review. We would genuinely appreciate it if you could reach out to us directly and share more details about your experience, so we can better understand what may have happened and work toward a solution.
Thank you Emily!
Thanks Patricia :)!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars!!
Friendly, knowledgeable and careful

We have been clients of this clinic for about 5 years and have been coming very frequently — at times at least twice a month — especially because we have a senior dog. We have always been extremely cautious  and proactive owners. Every small change, lump, or growth, we brought in immediately to be checked, specifically to rule out tumors or anything serious.
We also made it very clear on multiple occasions that cost is not a concern for us — our only priority has always been to do everything necessary (and more) to keep our dog safe and monitored.
Because of this, we trusted that our concerns were being taken seriously and that appropriate diagnostics would be done when needed.
However, over time we started noticing a pattern. Many visits felt quite surface-level, and for different issues the solution was often limited to prescribing anti-inflammatory medication (aka painkillers) without deeper investigation into the cause.
In addition, most of our appointments were scheduled with the first available doctor. More recently, seen by very junior or less experienced veterinarians and it often felt like there was not enough attention to investigate further.
Two weeks before a life-threatening situation, we visited the clinic again due to ongoing stomach issues. We clearly asked for a thorough check-up given his age and recurring symptoms. No additional diagnostics such as an ultrasound were performed or even suggested.
Shortly after, while we were traveling abroad with our dog and we took our dog to another veterinary clinic because something still didn’t feel right. There, they performed a very thorough examination including an ultrasound and x rays, and its just right aways felt so much more caring and more proffesional.
Within minutes, they discovered that our dog’s spleen was full of tumors and already bleeding internally, with a high risk of rupture at any moment. We were told this was an emergency life-threatening situation and surgery was scheduled within two days.
This was extremely difficult to process, especially considering how recently we had been at this clinic and how many times we had come in proactively over the years to prevent exactly this kind of situation.
When we informed the clinic about what had happened, we were told that they do not perform preventative ultrasounds in order to “avoid stressing the dog.” Given the severity of the condition that was missed, this explanation is very hard to accept.
After the surgery — which ultimately saved his life — we returned to this clinic for a follow-up of the post operation wound and requested in advance to see a senior vet due to the seriousness of the situation. Unfortunately, we arrived 4 minutes late due to traffic, and the way we were received was disappointing. We were told the appointment would be reduced to just 5 minutes. After everything that had happened, this felt dismissive and lacking basic understanding.
We are grateful that our dog survived thanks to another veterinary team. However, this experience has left us deeply disappointed and concerned.
We are sharing this not out of anger, but to highlight the importance of thorough diagnostics, especially for senior dogs, and to encourage other pet owners to insist on deeper investigation when something doesn’t feel right — even when they believe they are already doing everything right.

I sent there on 10/9/2025 to register my pets the young blond  lady on desk refused  to register them from the passports directly with bad attitude I know I have many  pets but this her work , she gave me long form to fill in , however I did that with all information of course the chip cods took some time  , to be surprised after half year  that she put only the names of the pet in the system no other information and never registered them at NDG even I asked her to do
Very lazy and unprofessional even she put wrong name and wrong address on the bill  , however the doctor was very helpful and professional and her colleagues as well .
Thanks! Do you have any tips for us on how we can turn it into 5 stars :)?

we had been frequent customer with our 4 pets for 6years. Event happened on June 5th 2021. It was a mistake of a new/young vet Charlotte. this new young inexperienced vet refused treatment to my other pet, she was also rude but it is ok. (I did not escalate this to animal health authorities with the treatment refusal procedure). In businesses, bad moments can always happen, and things can be easily fixed if management is on top of it. Management needs to watch new vets closer. It was a good vet overall when we used to lived close by.
Great caring staff and good service
They are great! Every visit is good!

Wherever you live in Amsterdam, cycle, walk, or drive out of your way to this animal clinic. Both the veterinarians and the staff behind the counter are truly wonderful: kind, dedicated, and compassionate. And importantly: honest. Even if they say exactly what you don't want to hear.
0 stars for me!

Over €2,000 poorer and a dead cat richer: the result of this animal clinic, where we thought we'd chosen one of the best in Amsterdam.

They let our sweet 10-year-old cat suffer unnecessarily for so long, under the guise that she would get better. When it turns out that's not going to happen, they blame you for your pet's suffering and blithely claim they'd discussed euthanasia with you several times... something that never happened. On Wednesday, pain relief was refused... On Thursday, she was injected with morphine for her final days. They would have preferred to put her down immediately... something we didn't want to put our cat through again.

On Monday, we took her to the Medical Center Animal Isolatorweg to say goodbye, because she couldn't cope anymore. After consulting with Vondelpark by phone through the MCD and reviewing the file, we were offered a reduced rate for euthanasia. This was because the MCD was concerned about the situation.

It was especially galling to hear that if she had come earlier, they would have given her another chance. They had experience with what she had, and their treatment plan sounded very plausible.

Unfortunately, you can't sue this practice yourself at the veterinary disciplinary board; only veterinarians individually. Next week we'll start with the worst and most heartless.

Attached is a photo of our sweet cat after her last visit to Vondelpark, together with her mother.

I gave it 2 stars because the English-speaking veterinarian who last treated our cat was kind to our cat and honest with us, including the staff at the reception desk. Otherwise, it would have been 1 star.
Thank you :)!

Honestly, the best vet clinic I have ever been to. A few months ago, me and my partner got ourselves a kitten, and it’s definitely been a learning experience 😅 However, Dierenkliniek Vondelpark was really helpful to us throughout this whole proces (with patience, advice, and a whole lot of kindness). I was also really impressed at the lengths they go to to ensure that your cat remains calm and that vet visits are not a scary experience. You can really see that everyone there puts heart and soul into what they do, and I can only offer them the highest praise and recommend them honestly to everyone I know.
friendly and professional staff

This clinic is a dream! The kindness and the attention for detail is amazing. Our cat Miso has felt immediately comfortable with Mariana, who’s such a kind person. He even got a treat! We won the lottery with this one. This clinic makes the visits a breeze.
Thank you Helena :)!

Together with their Spaarne location, this is the best vet practice we had in years and multiple countries. Nice, caring staff and vets who understand that you need a plan and a roadmap when your pets are unwell.

Just moved to the neighborhood. Our first appointment was fantastic honestly the best one I ever had. The staff is super sweet and kind. The Dr took her time to do a really deep check and answer all my questions explain when the following vaccination was coming etc. Thank you so much happy to know my pup is going to be in good hands.
Extremely professional, kind, and caring. Highly recommended!
They have great vets and nurses there. They always give the best treat to my cats.
Thank you!!
Most expensive place in Amsterdam.
Thank you :)
Our go-to Vet, has been for 5 years. Very good service, very good staff and Dog is always happy

Great clinic. Just changed from another big vet clinic in Amsterdam and already can tell this place is more responsive, more flexible in difficult situations and finds time if you have more urgent situations with your pet.

The staff here are excellent - attentive, kind, and caring. They have an English option when you call and an English speaking vet on staff, for those of us who don’t speak fluently enough to talk in depth about animals in Dutch. I went in for a consultation initially because I thought my new kitty needed to be spayed. The vet looked her over, was very sweet with her, made numerous suggestions, and answered every question I had. As we talked, she sent me emails with information about the things discussed so that I had the information handy when I returned home. I did take my kitty in for a spay, and in a weird turn of events, received a phone call 30 minutes after putting her under saying that she already had a scar - possibly from a previous surgery? We weren’t if she’d already been spayed (she was a stray), so they did a quick exploratory surgery. I appreciated the call and the options received. When I came to pick her up afterwards the woman at the front desk gave me aftercare information and a complimentary can of food for digestion because her belly would be sensitive - a nice touch! They also said they’d be open until 20.00 and to call with any questions, I called at 19.50, they picked up, answered my questions, and even told me to give Tompouce a little cuddle for them. 6 days later, I sent an email with an image of the incision to make sure she’s healing well and they responded right away. They were on time with both appointments, made everything stress free, and offered lots of care. Great vet, I’m extremely impressed.

I honestly can’t say enough good things about Dierenkliniek Vondelpark! They’ve taken such amazing care of my cat, Tom, and I’m so grateful for how kind, gentle, and professional everyone there is. You can really tell they love animals and truly care about what they do — it’s not about money for them, it’s about helping your pet feel better and making sure you feel supported too.

Every time I’ve been there, they’ve taken the time to explain everything clearly, answer all my questions, and make Tom feel calm and safe (which is not easy with a nervous cat 😅). The whole team is friendly and welcoming, and the clinic itself feels warm and trustworthy.

I’m super happy I found this place — I wouldn’t take Tom anywhere else. Highly, highly recommend Dierenkliniek Vondelpark to anyone who wants their pet to be treated with genuine care and respect! 🐾❤️

We said goodbye to our dog Rolo last week, and through this terrible time, we couldn't have asked for more support, kindness & care from the whole team. I just want to say a huge thank you - particularly Maaike & Sara. You went above and beyond to make us & Rolo comfortable in her last few weeks.
Thanks you Scott!
Thank you :)
No matter which dog we bring, besides our own Maylo, we also look after other people's dogs—always just as nice and good.

I booked my Frenchie in here for his return to UK wormer/Health Check.
The reception staff were wonderful on the phone & in person & the vet was something else!
Honestly couldn't recommend anywhere better!! Thank you
A very good clinic.
Thank you!

I brought my dog, Sheila, to this clinic about 2–3 weeks ago for localized itching. The veterinarian told me the cytology result would be available the next day. Instead, I received no written communication for weeks. There was one missed call from a Dutch number — no voicemail, no email, no WhatsApp — despite the clinic having all my contact details.

I travel extensively for work, often across time zones, so I sometimes miss calls. In this case, the call came from a different number than the clinic’s main line I had saved for booking, so I had no way to know it was them or that I should return that specific call. When I eventually contacted the clinic, I was told the cytology was positive for bacteria with inflammatory cells and that treatment was needed.

I was also told there is a policy that if a client misses a call, the client must call back. This policy was never disclosed to me at the appointment or in writing. I had hoped that, knowing my dog was ill, the veterinarian would ensure I actually received this information. Instead, it felt like the priority was to show that “the rules were followed,” rather than to make sure my dog received timely care.

We are heartbroken over the loss of our beloved cat, Luna. Our experience with Dierenkliniek Vondelpark highlighted significant negligence and a lack of proper equipment, which we believe ultimately led to her painful passing.

Initially, we brought Luna to the vet due to her shortness of breath, where a scan revealed a potential lung tumor based on a “mass behind the left lung.” Throughout that week, I contacted the clinic multiple times and visited almost every day, expressing my growing concerns as Luna’s condition deteriorated.

During her treatment at Dierenkliniek Vondelpark, we took Luna to the MCD emergency clinic for immediate help, but after being told they didn’t find anything in her lung, we returned to Dierenkliniek. Despite her alarming temperature of 40.5°C, Dierenkliniek Vondelpark lacked the necessary resources to conduct a thorough examination. Instead, we were sent home with antibiotics and Prednisol and advised to call back the next day. Unfortunately, Luna continued to decline, becoming increasingly lethargic and refusing to eat or drink. Eventually, we had to bring her back to MCD for critical care, where urgent tests revealed a perforation in her small intestine. Although the surgery appeared to go well, Luna’s condition remained critical, and after two days, she sadly passed away.

Adding to our grief was the information we received at MCD, which confirmed that Luna did not have lung cancer, contradicting the initial speculations made by Dierenkliniek Vondelpark. Had the vets taken immediate and appropriate action—rather than sending us home and delaying necessary tests—we believe we could have spared Luna from her suffering.

No words can bring our Luna back or alleviate the profound sadness we feel. We firmly believe that the negligence displayed by Dierenkliniek Vondelpark significantly contributed to her suffering and tragic ending.

Always very satisfied with the care and service here. They listen attentively and think along with you, so you don't feel like just a number. A great veterinary clinic where we are always welcome with Leo.
